title: MORE AMMO WHEN YOU RUN DRY
why: his order 10-27: player should have higher chance of finding ammo boxes if player has no ammo; a box searched by a pillager with nothing left to reload holds an ammo box about 7 times in 10 instead of about 1 in 4
now: more ammo boxes when you run dry
